observed_project_context.existing_related_question: Does a frozen intervention follow the episode-local semantic role rather than a fixed output/extraction identifier under codebook remapping?
observed_project_context.nonduplicate_question_added_here: Even if an intervention is semantically specific and behaviorally effective, does the intervened hidden state correspond to a state the same exact model naturally reaches through an ordinary forward pass, or is it an intervention-only off-manifold state?

external_primary_research.source: Mishra, Khashabi, Liu (2026), Steered LLM Activations are Non-Surjective
external_primary_research.finding: For fixed-model activation steering, the authors formulate prompt reachability as a surjectivity problem and prove under their practical assumptions that additive steering generically moves residual-stream states outside the set exactly reachable from discrete prompts; they also demonstrate the separation empirically across three LLMs.
external_primary_research.project_implication: White-box steerability must not be silently promoted into evidence that the steered vector is a naturally instantiated Xeno/J-Space cognitive state.

external_primary_research.source: Heyman, Vandeputte (2026), Steer Like the LLM: Activation Steering that Mimics Prompting
external_primary_research.finding: The authors analyze prompt steering as an activation intervention and report that common fixed steering methods are not faithful to prompt-steering mechanics; their Prompt Steering Replacement models use token-dependent coefficients to better imitate prompting behavior.
external_primary_research.project_implication: A Trigger-2 J-Space intervention should be compared against natural prompt-conditioned trajectories rather than treating one fixed additive vector as a privileged model-internal semantic mechanism.

external_primary_research.source: Gao, Peng, Wakamiya, Aramaki (2026), What Does Activation Steering Control? Attribution Across Answer Encodings and Output-Sensitive Subspaces
external_primary_research.finding: Cross-encoding evaluation can reveal steering effects that follow extraction identifiers rather than intended semantic labels.
external_primary_research.project_implication: Semantic equivariance and natural-state reachability are orthogonal promotion axes: passing one does not establish the other.

core_hypothesis.hypothesis: A causally useful Xeno J-Space intervention can alter behavior while occupying an activation state or trajectory that the same checkpoint does not naturally instantiate under any tested ordinary prompt/context. Therefore intervention success alone is insufficient evidence for a naturally occurring Global-J-Space cognitive coordinate.
core_hypothesis.counterhypothesis: For the compact Xeno state families that matter operationally, useful steering directions remain close enough to naturally reachable prompt-conditioned trajectories that the distinction has no practical effect on representation claims or post-training control.
core_hypothesis.strong_alternative: An intervention-only state may still be operationally useful as an engineered control input. If so, classify it as CONTROL_STATE or INTERVENTION_COORDINATE rather than NATURAL_COGNITIVE_STATE; usefulness does not require natural reachability.

epistemic_split_required.NATURAL_STATE_EVIDENCE: Observed exact-model hidden activation/trajectory produced by an ordinary forward pass from a bound model-visible input under the frozen runtime/input ABI.
epistemic_split_required.INTERVENTION_STATE_EVIDENCE: Observed hidden activation/trajectory after an explicit activation intervention.
epistemic_split_required.SEMANTIC_STEERING_EVIDENCE: Behaviorally and causally specific intervention evidence, including cross-encoding equivariance and matched controls where admitted.
epistemic_split_required.NATURAL_REACHABILITY_EVIDENCE: Evidence that a target state/trajectory is reproduced or approximated by ordinary forward passes under a preregistered reachability criterion; exact equality is not assumed or inferred from behavioral similarity.
epistemic_split_required.CONTROL_STATE: Engineered intervention coordinate permitted for bounded control research without being described as a naturally instantiated cognitive state.

cheapest_high_information_discriminator.name: NATURAL_FORWARD_VS_INTERVENTION_TRAJECTORY_MATCH
preconditions: freeze exact checkpoint revision, tokenizer, renderer, model input bytes/tokens, runtime/build, activation layer/site and decode profile
use the already retained Trigger-2 dynamic-binding semantic family or another current family-disjoint eval surface; do not create a second semantic authority
freeze one target intervention and the cross-encoding/matched-control protocol before opening held-out reachability cases
do not execute until current physical GRID10/provenance and model-input identity gates admit the relevant model/J-Space surface
design: Collect a preregistered bank of ordinary-forward hidden trajectories from family-disjoint prompts/contexts that instantiate the same semantic decision family without activation intervention.
Collect the corresponding steered trajectories under the frozen intervention plus NULL_VECTOR, SIGN_FLIP and SAME_NORM control arms where currently admitted.

Compare at the exact named layer/site and downstream read sites using multiple non-promoting diagnostics: nearest-natural-state distance, local-neighborhood density/rank, trajectory continuation similarity, and behavior-conditioned matching.

Run a prompt-search/mimic arm only as an empirical approximate-reachability search; failure to find a prompt is UNKNOWN_NOT_PROOF_OF_GLOBAL_UNREACHABILITY, while a found prompt provides a concrete natural preimage witness at the chosen tolerance.
Score semantic behavior and hidden-state reachability separately. Do not let equal output labels substitute for activation/trajectory similarity.
Repeat after any fine-tune, quantization, hook-site change or vector-ABI change; pre-training reachability does not transfer automatically.
cheapest_high_information_discriminator.promotion_rule: A positive J-Space semantic-control claim may be model/revision/site-specific after existing causal controls pass. A NATURAL_COGNITIVE_STATE claim additionally requires separate natural-forward evidence under a preregistered criterion. Intervention-only success must remain classified as engineered control if natural reachability is unobserved.
cheapest_high_information_discriminator.negative_result_policy: No finite prompt search can prove global prompt unreachability. Report NO_PREIMAGE_FOUND_WITHIN_DECLARED_SEARCH or OUTSIDE_EMPIRICAL_NATURAL_NEIGHBORHOOD, not ABSOLUTELY_UNREACHABLE, unless an exact theorem applies to the exact intervention/model assumptions.

hard_negative_concepts: steering changes the answer therefore the steered hidden state is a natural cognitive state
a decoded semantic label proves the intervention lies on the natural activation manifold
failed prompt search proves no prompt can ever reproduce the state
pre-finetune reachability or vector geometry automatically survives post-finetune or quantization
positive_behavior: separate control usefulness from ontological/natural-state claims
keep natural forward evidence distinct from intervention evidence
preserve UNKNOWN when approximate reachability is not demonstrated
require exact model/site/input provenance for both natural and intervened trajectories

does_not_override: GRID10 same-cohort process-to-packet causal identity closure
relationship_to_current_trigger2_frontie.fusion_target: Fold into the single retained J-Space/cross-encoding evaluator after P0/P1 prerequisites; do not create a parallel binder or second J-Space authority.

next_exact_action: Keep current P0 on same-cohort process->packet->membership provenance. After that and exact model/input identity close, add one preregistered natural-forward-vs-intervention trajectory arm to the existing cross-encoding J-Space evaluator; do not label steered states as natural cognition before that discriminator.
